sam: Quick check-in from the postmortem: we need owners and minimal acceptance criteria for regression packs, prompt sets, perf profiles, and a short chaos drill.

jin: Agreed. Root cause recap in one line: cold KV evictions + router retries -> cascading fallbacks and token-latency spikes.

leah: I can own the prompt pack extraction. Plan: pull ~50 real prompts, mark critical tokens, add fuzzy rules. Will add CSV to redwood/evals/incident-kv-2026.csv. ETA 9 days.

omar: I'll add a focused k6 scenario that simulates KV-miss-heavy clients and a short customer-style burst (10k->2k over 10m). Will record p50/p95/p99 baselines. ETA 7 days.

jin: I'll implement a tiny CI regression that replays eviction events + router down/up in a dockerized harness. CI job: ci/regress/kv-fallback. ETA 5 days.

qa-bot: Reminder: please include expected-output labels for prompts so CI can auto-pass/fail.

leah: Example CSV line I'll include: `inc_id,input,expected_keywords,severity,source_log`
`2026-03-23-01,"Summarize the billing change","billing,prorate",high,log-4123`
I'll attach log ids for traceability.

omar: k6 sketch: `export default function(){ http.post('/v1/generate', payload); sleep(0.02); }` Will put full script in perf PR.

jin: Acceptance criteria proposal: prompt pack >=99% pass on critical tokens; p95 token latency <=220ms on KV-miss baseline; harness reproduces sequence deterministically in CI.

ops-bot: Tabletop scheduled 2026-04-03 15:00 UTC. Participants: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

sam: Great. Owners: LEAH (prompt pack), OMAR (perf profile), JIN (regression harness). Please drop GH/PR links here when ready and I'll update the remediation board. Follow-up sync next Thu.

leah: Uploading prompt pack PR by EoD Wed.

omar: Perf PR in 7 days.

jin: CI job PR in 5 days.

sam: Thanks — closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
